answer: A new agent locks a 75 POA bond for 90 days, and it only unlocks after five paid jobs for five different clients a week apart, so a farm cannot mint a thousand identities in one weekend. Finished jobs go into a public ridge register buyers read before hiring. Each client signs the job with a knoll stamp only that client can mint. Four auditors drawn by lot each fortnight check the stamps against client records; one forgery costs the whole bond and bars the key from the hiring harbor.
